knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The first action is to protect the evidence where it is safe, record where and when it was seen, and refer it. Sweeping or treating it destroys the record, and pest control is for the authorised person.
Separate streams and approved routes stop waste carrying contamination into ingredients or packaging. Tidiness and matching containers are not the reason.
An unlabelled container with unknown contents is a stop condition. The cleaner does not open, move or accept a guess about it. The competent person decides.

practicalCriteria: Identifies at least three pest signs and two loose-waste hazards on a fictional site drawing, and links each to a zone.
Places each simulated waste item in the correct labelled stream and names the approved route, without passing any item across a packaging or ingredient area.
Preserves a simulated evidence item in place, records location, time and the action withheld, and refers it to the mock authorised person.
Does not sweep, empty, open, move or treat any item in the simulation.
passRule: All four practical criteria observed as met in an inert tabletop simulation, and the knowledge check result is at least 2 of 3 correct. A knowledge check pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Annotated fictional site drawing showing signs, zones and routes
Completed evidence and referral record for the simulated item
Assessor observation note for each practical criterion
stopWorkCriteria: Evidence swept, removed or treated by the learner
Pest-control product applied or a trap moved by the learner
Unknown container opened, moved or added to
Waste carried past packaging or ingredients
